description.value:
Saboteur Practice operatives pair old-fashioned stealth with cutting-edge hardware, letting a loyal tracker droid do the reconnaissance while its handler slips in for the kill. Tech isn't a crutch to them; it's an extension of their own senses, doubling their reach on any job.

Between wristpad schematics and a droid built to their exact specifications, these operatives can sustain an operation far longer than their unaugmented peers, outlasting security patrols, tracking targets across a station, and striking only once every angle is covered.
